AcademicReviewRequestItem.name: AcademicReviewRequestItem
AcademicReviewRequestItem.description: Represents a junction between academic review request and the related items.

AcademicReviewRequestId.description: The academic review request record that's associated with the academic review request item.

LastReferencedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last accessed this record, a record related to this record, or a list view.

LastViewedDate.description: The timestamp when the current user last viewed this record or list view. If this value is null, the user might have only accessed this record or list view (LastReferencedDate) but not viewed it.

RelatedItemId.description: The record for which the approval request was raised.
